description: interior of aim_blend_makes_a_straight_line on a chain running down -X with the joints' +X pointing back. The end control moves 2 up and both aim blends are 1, so the base curve is the straight line (-8u, 2u) and the joints are at (0,0), (-2,0.5), (-4,1), (-6,1.5), (-8,2). Each joint's rest forward direction is (-1,0,0), at 180 degrees. The line's direction (-8,2) is at atan2(2,-8) = 165.9638 degrees, so every joint turns 165.9638 - 180 = -14.0362 about Z.
